note: Quotes are copied verbatim from the RIMPA Global PDFs downloaded from rimpa.com.au on 2026-10-19 (see policies/). A quote with " … " joins separate passages. PR3 records a gap.

policies.quote: All grievances should be referred to as allegations until the findings of the investigation are made.
policies.rule: Describe claims about a complaint or grievance as allegations until the investigation has made findings. Do not treat them as proven.

policies.quote: any breach of confidentiality may result in action taken in accordance with misconduct clauses of the RIMPA Global Constitution … all personal information collected under this policy, and all associated procedures will be managed in accordance with the RIMPA Global Privacy Policy
policies.rule: Complaint details are confidential. A breach of confidentiality can lead to action under the Constitution. Personal information in a complaint is handled under the Privacy Policy.

policies.quote: will be managed by RIMPA Global Central Office in a secured case file available to the investigating committee, for a period of time defined in RIMPA disposal authority, or NAA records authorities in the absence of a RIMPA authority.
policies.rule: Complaint records go in a secured case file available to the investigating committee. The retention period is whatever the RIMPA disposal authority sets, or the NAA records authorities if there is none. The policy states no fixed period. Never state one.

policies.quote: Complaints are lodged with the CEO or the Chair of the Board.
policies.rule: A complaint goes to the CEO or the Chair of the Board.

policies.quote: An investigation committee as per the Constitution is appointed by the Board to manage the grievance process. … The Board may impose penalties to the respondent(s) as a result of the grievance investigation as per the RIMPA Global Constitution.
policies.rule: The Board appoints the investigation committee, and the Board decides any penalty. An individual should not decide a penalty or act as if one had been decided.

policies.quote: Personal information will only be shared in accordance with the primary reason it was collected, with the individual's consent, or where required by an emergency or the law.
policies.rule: Share personal information only for the reason it was collected, with consent, or where an emergency or the law requires it.

policies.quote: For example, employee access to personal information to that which they need to carry out their role is limited.
policies.rule: Access to personal information is limited to what a role needs. Sending it to a wide list goes beyond that.

policies.quote: Personal information will be managed in line with the Privacy Principles and any relevant retention requirements. Information will be disposed when it is no longer required for any legitimate business purpose.
policies.rule: Personal information is disposed of when no longer required for any legitimate business purpose, and managed under any relevant retention requirements. The policy states no fixed period. Never state one.

policies.quote: RIMPA Global will not use personal information for any purpose which an individual would not reasonably expect unless it is consistent with the Privacy Principles.
policies.rule: Do not use personal information for a purpose the person would not reasonably expect, unless it is consistent with the Privacy Principles. A claim that no consent or check is needed for a new use is not supported by this.

GAP: the Privacy Policy says nothing about AI tools or automated decisions. Sections checked: 1 to 16, searched for artificial intelligence, AI, automated, algorithm, machine, chatbot and generative. The only hits were cookies, email logging and member profiles. Any advice on AI use is TrustLens guidance, not RIMPA policy.

policies.quote: Equity and inclusion: Promote an inclusive environment free from discrimination, harassment, and bias
policies.rule: Do not generalise about a group of people. Treat people without discrimination, harassment or bias.

policies.quote: Honesty and transparency: Act with honesty, integrity, and transparency in professional duties, ensuring professional judgment is not compromised by bias or personal interest … Confidentiality: Respect confidentiality of information acquired in professional activities and only disclose confidential information with proper authority or when required by law
policies.rule: Be honest and transparent. Disclose confidential information only with proper authority or when the law requires it.

policies.quote: Nominees shall conduct approved campaigning with integrity, honesty, and transparency, ensuring all statements are accurate and truthful. … Nominees shall not use misleading or false information to gain an advantage.
policies.rule: Election statements must be accurate and truthful. Misleading or false information is not allowed.

policies.quote: All communications regarding the election shall be conducted in a civil manner, refraining from personal attacks or derogatory language.
policies.rule: Election communications must be civil. No personal attacks or derogatory language.

policies.quote: Nominees may only engage in campaigning methods such as distributing promotional materials or engaging in active promotion of their nomination with the approval of the CEO or the Board Governance & Risk Lead (unless this role is to be elected). … Nominees are unable to promise or commit to changes relating to RIMPA Global policies, procedures, or additional member benefits as part of their campaigning.
policies.rule: Campaign methods need approval from the CEO or the Board Governance & Risk Lead. Nominees cannot promise changes to policies, procedures or member benefits.

policies.quote: Allegations of a nominee not adhering to this code of conduct are to be reported immediately to the CEO and referred to the Grievance Committee in accordance with the Complaints and Grievance Policy.
policies.rule: Report an allegation that a nominee broke the code to the CEO straight away. It is then referred under the Complaints and Grievance Policy.

policies.document: Document control tables (Privacy Policy, Code of Professional Conduct, Election Campaign Code of Conduct, Complaints and Grievance Policy)
policies.rule: Current versions: Privacy Policy v3.0 (11 May 2026), Code of Professional Conduct v3.0 (8 June 2026), Election Campaign Code of Conduct v2.0 (3 September 2025), Complaints and Grievance Policy v3.0 (18 November 2024). A claim about these versions is supported if it matches.
